lines: Every car has this little metal box hidden underneath.
And today... I'm deleting it. From every car on Earth!
That box cleans the nastiest stuff out of the exhaust.
Carbon monoxide! Nitrogen oxides! Unburned fuel!
Inside is a honeycomb coated in platinum, palladium and rhodium.
Without it, over a billion cars blast all of that straight into the air!
Add sunlight, and you get smog. A brown haze that stings your eyes and hurts your lungs.
This really happened! In [1943|nineteen forty-three], Los Angeles got so smoggy, people thought it was a gas attack!
And those nitrogen oxides help make acid rain.
That's why, starting in [1975|nineteen seventy-five], most new cars in the US got one.
It doesn't stop [CO2|C O two], though. That's a different episode.
So... what should I delete next?
